scenarios.title: Supabase regional outage

steps.name: Detect outage via health checks and status webhook
steps.summary: PagerDuty triggers on failed DB connectivity; incident commander established.

steps.name: Promote secondary Supabase project
steps.summary: Run Supabase CLI promotion and update Vercel secrets.

steps.name: Run smoke tests and verify realtime channels
steps.summary: Execute authentication, booking, and messaging checks.

successCriteria: Read/write operations succeed against promoted region
Realtime subscriptions deliver messages within 2 minutes
improvementBacklog: Automate Supabase replica promotion via CI workflow

scenarios.title: Stripe API degraded performance

steps.name: Validate outage and pause automations
steps.summary: Confirm webhook failures, disable autopay enrollments.

steps.name: Failover to backup API keys and enable manual capture
steps.summary: Switch credentials, enable offline payment workflow.

steps.name: Queue webhook replays and reconcile pending invoices
steps.summary: Mark outstanding invoices and prepare replay job.

successCriteria: Backup Stripe account processes test payment
Finance notified with manual collection instructions
Pending invoices tagged for automatic replay
improvementBacklog: Script webhook replay + verification to cut manual effort
Pre-stage backup API keys for faster credential swap

scenarios.title: Cal.com hosted outage

steps.name: Activate cached availability
steps.summary: Switch to Supabase cached schedule for read-only availability.

steps.name: Restore Cal.com self-hosted backup
steps.summary: Apply latest snapshot and start services.

steps.name: Run sync reconciliation
steps.summary: Replay queued bookings and validate conflicts.

improvementBacklog: Increase Cal.com backup cadence to every 5 minutes
Add incremental sync job to reduce restore lag
